channel.title: Russia's war in Ukraine · Varde Monitor
channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in Russia's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has continued to use naval drones to strike Russian warships at Libya’s Benghazi port, prompting Zelensky to say Ukraine can attack wherever it wants. Russian forces have violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle, while Russia is reportedly preparing to place a nuclear weapon in space within 60 days, according to a German warning. The UN reports that civilian casualties in Ukraine in 2026 already far exceed previous years, and Zelensky has called for four-way peace talks with Russia, Europe and the US. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
